goal: Keep Codex behind one deterministic authorization Interface as an optional Advanced Executor that never owns DC-Agent scheduling or runtime control.

acceptance_criteria.description: Only known Codex capabilities authorized by a user or the Deterministic Controller are allowed.
Every request that gives Codex ownership of scheduling is denied regardless of capability or authorizer.
The CLI reasoning, OAuth image generation, and deterministic incident diagnosis Adapters authorize through the shared Codex capability Interface before execution.
One deterministic capability catalog supplies the truthful Codex tools shown in Feishu and Dashboard, including authority, entrypoints, execution mode, and no scheduler ownership.
The dedicated #codex工具 marker and Feishu Codex confirmation route to the real read-only CLI Adapter, while existing #codex model-pin semantics remain unchanged.
Every real Codex CLI execution creates a Harness task and append-only start/finish timeline without persisting the complete prompt, complete answer, or command preview.
Local project development requires the exact gpt-5.6-sol model with reasoning effort high, xhigh, or max, defaults to max, and rejects invalid requests before starting a subprocess.
acceptance_criteria.verification: uv run python scripts/run_cross_suite_pytests.py --dc-engine dc_engines/tests/test_codex_capability.py --root tests/dc_router/test_cli_runner.py

acceptance_criteria.description: Workspace-write project development is authorized only for the local operator, is never exposed through Feishu, and never gives Codex scheduler ownership.
